Leaflet — BSD 2-Clause License
==============================

This licence text accompanies the Leaflet files vendored into this repository:

    vendor/javascript/leaflet.js
    vendor/assets/stylesheets/leaflet/leaflet.css
    vendor/assets/stylesheets/leaflet/images/*.png

PROVENANCE OF THIS FILE (so it can be checked, not trusted):
  · The copyright lines below are transcribed VERBATIM from the `@preserve`
    banner inside vendor/javascript/leaflet.js as vendored here (Leaflet 1.9.4,
    downloaded from https://ga.jspm.io/npm:leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet-src.js).
  · The licence body is the standard, unmodified OSI text of BSD-2-Clause, which
    is the licence Leaflet is released under. It is reproduced here because the
    jspm-delivered bundle ships without a LICENSE file, while leaflet.css and the
    marker/layer sprites carry no notice of their own at all — and BSD-2-Clause
    requires the notice to travel WITH the redistributed source.
  · Canonical upstream: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/blob/main/LICENSE
